interpretation: Controlled synthetic evidence-channel analysis. Structural, cohort-relative, and behavioral evidence are reported separately. Behavioral observations were predeclared before pairwise measurement and do not force every provenance-related pair to share a failure. Results characterize this synthetic cohort only and do not establish plagiarism-detection accuracy, causal provenance, or general superiority.

protocol.interpretation: Structural, cohort-relative, and behavioral evidence are reported as separate channels. The primary label view treats within-family pairs as related and cross-family pairs as controls. Normalized and structural similarity collisions are analyzed without introducing a combined score, plagiarism threshold, automated verdict, or post-hoc relabeling.
